preconditions.expression: all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz' for c in stdin)
preconditions.description: The input string contains only lower-case Latin letters.
The input string contains at most 30 characters.

postconditions.description: The output is a substring of the input string.

postconditions.expression: all(stdout == stdin[i:i+len(stdout)] for i in range(len(stdin)) if stdin[i:i+len(stdout)] == stdout)
postconditions.description: The output substring is repeated in the input string.

postconditions.expression: all(len(stdout) >= len(substring) for substring in substrings if stdin.count(substring) == max_count)
postconditions.description: The output substring has the maximal length among substrings with the maximal repeat time.

postconditions.expression: all(stdout >= substring for substring in substrings if len(substring) == len(stdout) and stdin.count(substring) == max_count)
postconditions.description: In case of a tie, the output substring is the alphabetically latest one.
